decisions.reason: As a core general interior luminaire aligned with the firm's building-solutions strategy, it likely exceeds its aspiration level, so the chance of withdrawal remains very low.
As the flagship pendant with microprismatic optics at the center of the sustainable lighting direction, the firm uses organizational slack to keep it despite any residual uncertainty.

Although marine HMI searchlights leverage the firm's testing capabilities, the narrow niche and the prior withdrawal of related marine products raise the risk that results fall short of aspirations, but slack still supports carrying it while evaluating demand.
